root_cause: The literal Next.js route selected the static V2 page before the dynamic token route, and that page resolved the Fitness base token without an exact-token lookup.
repair: PortalReport supports a fallback only after its initial exact token has no population. The V2 page starts with local-fitness-review-v2/classic and uses local-fitness-review/sidebar solely as that fallback.
collision_controls: an existing local-fitness-review-v2 population renders only its classic signed report
an absent local-fitness-review-v2 token falls back to local-fitness-review with sidebar presentation
both exact and fallback branches preserve the approved V2 period-selector URL
